PresentationGraphService no longer includes BasicPostprocessing.h or PostProcessingState.h and holds no pipeline, state, or descriptor pool: it imports the swapchain image, clears, records the host's content and capture

the backdrop is drawn through ISurfaceBackdropWriter (declared in SurfaceImage.h); the implementation is SurfaceWritePass, a renderer-side pass that reuses BasicPostprocessing in passThrough with no new shader

a first attempt added a SurfaceResample shader and pipeline class and was removed: the surface write is a postprocess-shaped job, and a second pipeline type is just another place a grading stage can be reintroduced
FSurfaceImage carries EImageEncoding (Linear / DisplayEncoded) next to the image, so the one fact a format cannot express travels with it

findSurfaceImageMismatch refuses exactly one of the four pairings -- DisplayEncoded into a surface whose format encodes on write (sRGB) -- and reports it as an error instead of drawing; the pass still runs so the host's content is unaffected
Linear into sRGB is the hardware-encoding path and is accepted, not treated as an error
RenderDeviceState::getViewDisplayImage labels the raw-color fallback Linear rather than guessing DisplayEncoded
SurfaceImageTest locks the four pairings and that isSRGB is the gate's only input
an editor authoring View is still a display root by compose structure (composeOntoViewId == 0) for publish identity and view extent, but being a display root no longer means the window shows it
bEnableGammaCorrection=false writes a linear image on both paths now; whether the switch should exist is undecided
